external_scale_checks.reported_quantity: East African Rift integrated lithosphere strength of about 30-80 MPa for a 100 km lithosphere, i.e. 3-8 TN/m; estimated tectonic stresses about 1-2.2 TN/m.

external_scale_checks.use: Thickness-context scenarios only; this paper's modeled thicknesses do not directly give strength values.

external_scale_checks.reported_quantity: Their isotropic rifting model has peak driving force about 22 TN/m; models with strong inherited anisotropy stay at or below 10 TN/m.
external_scale_checks.use: Load-scale context only; driving force is not lithosphere capacity and cannot be used as a capacity target.

limitations: No rupture/no-rupture observations are available for the matched replay candidates, so fitting a capacity multiplier to their candidate loads would be circular.

Replay nodes carry per-cell crustal thickness, mantle-lid thickness, crust type, craton share, belt history, Moho thermal lag, and restite; this audit fixes 35 km crust and does not evaluate that spatial field.
No full depth-temperature, pore-pressure, water, layer-mineralogy, grain-size, local strain-rate, fault-fabric, or K0 field is available; this keeps the capacity choice underidentified.
All thickness scenarios retain a 35 km crust; this is not representative of every rift or craton and keeps the result conditional on the current continental column proxy.
The literature checks use different definitions, averaging, boundary conditions, and constitutive assumptions; agreement in TN/m is only an order-of-magnitude check.
The matched replay population is conditionally selected: connected-source craton-crossing cuts only, not the 130 candidates or all tectonic states.

matched_replay_load_context.interpretation: Candidate loads from the old algorithm are not observed rupture/no-rupture labels and are not used to fit capacity.
matched_replay_load_context.population: 74 source-connected craton-crossing candidates, seeds 7, 11 and 2024; 22,896 cut-band node samples.

method.quantile_interpretation: Designed factorial grid summaries, not probabilities or posterior confidence intervals.
method.sweep: Existing 1,728-case continental factorial scenario grid, independently repeated at each thickness.
method.thickness_mapping: 35 km crust held fixed; remaining total thickness assigned to mantle lithosphere.
